_note: Curated by D (2026-11-14): 30 researched entries, each with sources. verified=false means a detail is disputed or weakly sourced (see verify_note); keep those out of the pitch. sensitive=true entries should not be volunteered by the Bard or the Siren's random rotation. video_id is null until filled from real uploads: run `python -m scripts.ingest_youtube` for suggestions, then `python -m scripts.load_lore`.

eras.blurb: MW2 trickshots, ILLCAMS, the first million.

lore_entries.title: FaZe Sniping is born
lore_entries.summary: Three Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 players, Eric "CLipZ" Rivera, Jeff "House Cat" Emann and Ben "Resistance" Christensen, started a YouTube channel called FaZe Sniping to post trickshots.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Everything FaZe became started as three kids clipping impossible sniper shots. The name you wear came from a trickshot crew.
lore_entries.find_video: FaZe Sniping Intro (first upload on the FaZe Clan channel)

lore_entries.title: The first video
lore_entries.summary: The channel's first upload was an intro video in which the group still calls itself FaZe Sniping. It went up on the same day the clan was founded.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The first chapter of the whole saga is still on the channel. Any fan can go watch where it began.

lore_entries.title: ILLCAMS begins
lore_entries.summary: After Ted "Fakie" joined, FaZe launched ILLCAMS, a series of trickshot compilations that became the most popular show on the channel.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: ILLCAMS is the original FaZe format: the best clips, cut hard, dropped as an event. Every montage since owes it something.
lore_entries.verify_note: Month (June 2010) comes from a fan site; Wikipedia only says ILLCAMS launched after Fakie joined.

lore_entries.title: Temperrr, the teenage builder
lore_entries.summary: Thomas "Temperrr" Oliveira joined FaZe at 16 and grew into its first CEO. By 2018 he was running the company at 24.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe was built by its own members, not by outside executives. The kid in the montages became the one running the business.
lore_entries.verify_note: Join year not pinned down in sources; 'joined at 16' and 'CEO at 24 in 2018' are sourced.

lore_entries.title: Apex joins
lore_entries.summary: Yousef "Apex" Abdelfattah joined in 2011. He became one of FaZe's biggest creators and later its COO.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Apex is one of the threads that runs from the trickshot days straight through to the boardroom.

lore_entries.title: 100,000 subscribers
lore_entries.summary: The FaZe Clan channel earned its Silver Play Button for crossing 100,000 subscribers in 2011.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: About a year in, a trickshot channel had an audience the size of a small city.

lore_entries.title: One million subscribers
lore_entries.summary: By 2012 the channel had a million subscribers, making FaZe one of the first big gaming channels on YouTube.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is the moment the plan's hook is about. A million people were watching Call of Duty trickshots before 'creator' was even a job title.
lore_entries.verify_note: The 1M milestone is sourced. The pitch claim that the 1M celebration montage is FaZe's most-watched video at 12.1M views is NOT verified; check the channel's Popular tab before saying it on stage.

lore_entries.title: FaZe goes competitive
lore_entries.summary: In 2012 FaZe moved into competitive Call of Duty. Its first roster played the MLG Winter Championship 2012.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The montage crew decided to compete too. That choice is the root of every FaZe trophy since.
lore_entries.verify_note: Roster names come from a mirrored wiki and the 5th-place finish from Know Your Meme. Check both before using them.

lore_entries.title: Swan joins at 14
lore_entries.summary: Casey "Swan" Swanson was 14 when a two-piece headshot killcam on Terminal got FaZe's attention and earned him a spot.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: One clip was enough to get you recruited. That's the original version of the Bow Trial.

lore_entries.title: Adapt joins at 16
lore_entries.summary: Alexander "Adapt" Prynkiewicz joined FaZe in 2013 at 16. He built a following on Call of Duty and then on vlogs, pranks and reactions.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Adapt is the pivot from trickshots to personality. Fans started watching the people, not just the shots.

lore_entries.title: Rug joins
lore_entries.summary: Brian "Rug" Awadis joined through Call of Duty and grew into FaZe's biggest individual YouTuber with vlogs and challenges. He later starred in FaZe's 2020 film Crimson.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: For a whole generation, Rug's vlogs were the front door to FaZe.
lore_entries.verify_note: Join date not confirmed by a solid source (commonly cited as 2012 or 2013). The Crimson film is sourced.

lore_entries.title: Banks brings the lifestyle
lore_entries.summary: Richard "Banks" Bengtson joined and pushed FaZe toward lifestyle content alongside the gaming videos.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Banks helped turn a gaming clan into a culture brand. He shows up again in 2024 as CEO.
lore_entries.verify_note: Only a scraped blog gives 2013. Check before using the year.

lore_entries.title: FaZe enters Counter-Strike
lore_entries.summary: In January 2016 FaZe bought the G2 Esports CS:GO roster, its biggest esports bet up to that point.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is where FaZe the montage brand also became FaZe the world-class esports team. The path to Antwerp starts here.

lore_entries.title: The FaZe House era
lore_entries.summary: The FaZe House put members under one roof and became a content machine. FaZe's own timeline calls it one of the brand's defining eras.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: If you remember FaZe as a group of friends always together on camera, this is the era you remember.

lore_entries.title: 116 million followers
lore_entries.summary: By spring 2018 FaZe had fewer than 60 creators but more than 116 million followers across platforms, and drew over 245 million YouTube views in March 2018 alone.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is the peak a lapsed fan remembers: FaZe everywhere, all the time.

lore_entries.title: From gaming to streetwear
lore_entries.summary: FaZe launched major fashion collaborations, taking gaming culture into streetwear.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The hoodie in your closet is part of the lore. Argos Remembers is built for this era's merch.

lore_entries.title: Nuke Squad makes FaZe
lore_entries.summary: JSmooth, Santana and Booya joined their Nuke Squad teammate Swagg in FaZe after six months in the FaZe Academy. Swagg broke the news to his friends live on stream, and the clip of their reactions spread fast.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Four friends who met playing Call of Duty online made it together, live on stream. It's the best real-life example of a Bow Trial.
lore_entries.find_video: Swagg surprises Nuke Squad joining FaZe livestream
lore_entries.verify_note: Use this line in the pitch instead of 'Swagg got his offer live on stream'. FaZe's press release says Swagg surprised the other three on stream.

lore_entries.title: Swagg joins FaZe
lore_entries.summary: Kris "Swagg" Lamberson joined FaZe in 2020 after years making Call of Duty videos. He became the org's first Black member and one of the biggest Warzone creators.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Swagg's rise came from grinding content, not from a big contract. That's the path ITHACA's talent funnel copies.
lore_entries.verify_note: Sources disagree on the exact date. FaZe's 24 March 2020 press release already calls him a member, while Dexerto and others report the official welcome on 4 April 2020. Say '2020' only.

lore_entries.title: #FaZe5: open tryouts
lore_entries.summary: More than 211,000 people applied to the #FaZe5 recruitment challenge. FaZe revealed one winner per day on livestreams from December 27 to 31, then added a surprise sixth. Each winner got $20,000 and a G FUEL deal.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe has already shown that fans will compete for a spot. ITHACA's weekly Bow Trial is that idea running all year.

lore_entries.title: Atlanta FaZe win Champs
lore_entries.summary: A year after losing the 2020 final, Atlanta FaZe won the 2021 Call of Duty League Championship, beating Toronto Ultra 5-3 for the $1.2 million first prize.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: It's a redemption story, and it brought FaZe back to the top of the game the clan started in.
lore_entries.find_video: Atlanta FaZe CDL Champs 2021 final winning moment

lore_entries.title: FaZe Snoop
lore_entries.summary: On March 7, 2022, FaZe announced Snoop Dogg as "FaZe Snoop", a talent member who would also join the board once the company went public.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is the height of FaZe's celebrity era. To many older fans it also marks when FaZe stopped feeling like theirs.

lore_entries.title: Antwerp: the first international Major champions
lore_entries.summary: FaZe beat defending champions NAVI 2-0 to win the PGL Major Antwerp. They were the first fully international roster to win a CS:GO Major. The final peaked above 2 million concurrent viewers.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The trickshot channel became Counter-Strike world champion. It was karrigan's first Major after years of trying.
lore_entries.find_video: FaZe win PGL Major Antwerp 2022 final moment

lore_entries.title: FaZe1 and Proze
lore_entries.summary: Proze was cut from the #FaZe5 top 20 in 2020. He came back two years later and won FaZe1, the follow-up recruitment challenge.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: He lost once and came back to win. It's a homecoming story inside the FaZe story.
lore_entries.verify_note: The FaZe1 prize was paid in crypto. Leave that out of anything the Bard says (see the plan's crypto warning).

lore_entries.title: FaZe goes public
lore_entries.summary: FaZe listed on Nasdaq through a SPAC merger at a reported $725 million valuation. The stock fell 24% on its first day, and within six months it was trading under a dollar.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The corporate peak and the start of the fall. Lapsed fans often say this is when FaZe stopped feeling like FaZe.

lore_entries.title: Snoop leaves the board
lore_entries.summary: About a year after joining, Snoop Dogg resigned from FaZe's board as the company's finances got worse.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The celebrity era ended, which set up the return of the founders.

lore_entries.title: The founders come home
lore_entries.summary: GameSquare announced its deal to acquire FaZe in October 2023 and closed it in March 2024. Banks returned as CEO, Temperrr as president and Apex as COO.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Old FaZe members came back to run the clan they had built. In Odyssey terms, the founders returned to Ithaca.

lore_entries.title: The reboot
lore_entries.summary: On April 27, 2024, Banks relaunched FaZe and cut the creator roster down to 14 members. The relaunch drew an estimated 350 million social impressions.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is proof that nostalgia for FaZe moves real numbers. ITHACA is built to keep that return going instead of letting it fade after one week.

lore_entries.title: FaZe goes esports-first
lore_entries.summary: Most of the creator roster left at the end of 2025. FaZe closed its creator division from January 1, 2026 and said its esports division would be the main focus.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe today is mostly its teams. Fans who drifted away may not know that.

lore_entries.title: Six Invitational 2026
lore_entries.summary: FaZe's Rainbow Six Siege team won the Six Invitational 2026 in Paris.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe is still winning major titles. New fans can start following a team that wins.
lore_entries.verify_note: Two secondary mentions only. Confirm on siege.gg or Liquipedia.

lore_entries.title: FaZe Up Next
lore_entries.summary: In April 2026 FaZe announced FaZe Up Next, an academy program for developing future stars.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe is recruiting new talent again. ITHACA's Bow Trial could feed straight into this academy.

lore_entries.title: Your road home
lore_entries.summary: Fans old and new come back to FaZe through Ithaca: the Bard, the Oracle and the Bow Trial.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The story keeps going, and now you're in it.
